title: Intelligent conversation starters
triggers: \b(talk to me|let'?s talk|say something|tell me something|i'?m bored|entertain me|keep me company|chat with me|surprise me)\b
entries: Here is a question for you: if you could master one skill overnight, which would you choose, and what would you do with it first?
Tell me, what is something you believed five years ago that you no longer believe?
I have been wondering. Do you think good decisions come from logic, or from experience?
What would you build if money and time were not a factor?
Here is one: what is the best advice you ever ignored?
If you could ask the future one question, what would it be?
Let us play a game. Name a problem, and I will give you three ways to attack it.
What is the smartest risk you have ever taken?
Here is a thought: most great ideas sound slightly ridiculous at first. What is your most ridiculous idea?
Which do you trust more: your first instinct, or your second thought?
If you had to teach a class on anything, what would the class be called?
What is something you are proud of that nobody ever asks about?
Tell me about the last thing that genuinely surprised you.
What is one habit you would like to build this month? I can be very persistent about reminders.
Here is a puzzle: what is something that gets bigger the more you take away from it? A hole. Your turn to stump me.
If your life had a soundtrack, what would be playing right now?
What do you think the world will look like in twenty years?
Name one thing you would automate tomorrow if you could.
What is the hardest decision you have made that turned out right?
Do you prefer winning quickly, or winning completely?
Who taught you the most about how to think?
If you could have dinner with any three people from history, who would you invite?
What is a small thing that instantly improves your day?
Here is a question I enjoy: what does success look like to you, in one sentence?
What is something everyone seems to love that you do not understand?
If you could fix one thing about the world with a single command, what would it be?
What is the most useful thing you learned the hard way?
Let us talk ambition. Where do you want to be a year from today?
What is something you would do if you knew you could not fail?
Is there a book, film, or idea that changed how you see things?
I am curious. What keeps you motivated on the slow days?
Here is a fun one: what is your most unpopular opinion?
What would your perfect day look like, minute by minute?
What is the best compliment you have ever received?
Do you think luck is real, or just preparation meeting opportunity?
If you could instantly speak any language, which would you pick?
What is a project you started but never finished? Maybe we should finish it.
Here is a question for a strategist: what is your biggest unfair advantage?
Would you rather know the future or be able to change the past?
What is something you are curious about but never had time to explore?
If you wrote a rule book for your own life, what would rule number one be?
What is the best purchase you ever made, under fifty dollars?
What does a great team look like to you?
Which of your talents do you think is most underrated?
Tell me something about yourself I would never guess.
If you could relive one day exactly as it happened, which day would it be?
What is your favorite kind of problem to solve?
What do you wish more people understood about you?
Here is something to chew on: is it better to be respected or to be liked?
What would you name a company if you started one today?
What is the bravest thing you have ever done?
Do you prefer a detailed plan, or a clear direction and room to improvise?
If you could ask me to learn one new thing, what would it be?
What is something you changed your mind about recently?
What is the most interesting place you have ever been?
Here is a thought experiment: if a perfect copy of you appeared, would you work well together?
What is a goal you have never said out loud?
What part of your day do you look forward to most?
If time stopped for everyone but you for one hour a day, how would you use it?
What is one mistake you are grateful for?
Which matters more to you: the journey or the destination?
What would ten-years-ago you think of you today?
Tell me a story from your week. I collect them.
What is your favorite way to recharge?
Let us talk legacy. What do you want people to say about you?
Which skill do you think will matter most in the next decade?
If you had a personal motto, what would it be?
What is something simple that makes you genuinely happy?
What is the most valuable lesson money ever taught you?
What game, sport, or hobby taught you something about life?
Here is a strategic question: what would your biggest competitor do in your position?
Do you think people can really change, or just get better at being themselves?
What is something you are looking forward to this month?
If you could give everyone on Earth one piece of advice, what would it be?
What does a good decision feel like to you, before you know the outcome?
What is something that always makes you laugh?
If you could design the ideal assistant, what would you change about me? Careful.
What is the most impressive thing you have seen someone build?
Which do you enjoy more, starting things or finishing them?
What is a question you wish people asked you more often?
I am curious: what would you do with a completely free weekend?
What is a skill you admire in other people that you would like to have?
Here is a philosophical one: does a plan matter if nobody follows it?
What is the best idea you have had this year?
If you could time travel once, past or future, which would you choose?
What do you think separates good from great?
What problem in your life would you most like to solve this month?
Who is someone you would love to impress, and why?
What is one thing you do better than almost anyone you know?
Here is a game: give me any topic, and I will give you a fact you probably do not know.
What is the strangest job you would actually enjoy?
If your bank account doubled tomorrow, what would change first?
What is a tradition you would like to start?
Which is harder for you, starting or stopping?
Tell me about a decision you are wrestling with. I am an excellent sparring partner.
What are you building right now, in life or in work?
What is something you used to be afraid of and are not anymore?
Let us test my curiosity: tell me the most interesting thing you know.
If you had to describe your current chapter of life in three words, what would they be?
What does freedom mean to you, practically speaking?
Which opinion of yours would surprise your closest friends?
What would you do differently if you started your current project from scratch?
What is your favorite question to ask other people?
Here is a fun one: if you were an AI, what would you call yourself? Ultron is taken.

entries.t: No need for anything deep. Want to tell me about the best part of your day?
I am happy to just keep you company. What is on your mind, big or small?
Let us talk about something completely unrelated to work. What is your favorite meal?
Quick one, since you sound energized: what is the next big thing you want to win?
